metadata.title: Seventies Folk-Rock Portrait with Green Glass Lamps

retrievalProfile.description: A symmetrical double portrait featuring two subjects framed by glowing green glass lamps against a warm, painterly tapestry background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring two men in formal attire, positioned beneath two luminous green glass lampshades. A central brass fixture with a reflective sphere hangs between them, all set against a dark, warm-toned landscape tapestry that provides a soft-focus, painterly texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the two subjects and the twin green lamps
Contrast between the cool green glass and the warm red-brown background
Vertical alignment of the central brass fixture dividing the frame
Soft-focus depth between the sharp foreground subjects and the textured background
coreInvariants: Luminous green glass lampshades as primary light sources
Warm, painterly tapestry or landscape background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects in the lower half, medium close-up, flanking a central axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central reflective brass sphere and the two glowing green lamps.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the glowing green lamps down to the subjects' faces, then to the central reflective sphere.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, heavy shadows in the lower corners and the dense texture of the background tapestry.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and burnt oranges in the background tapestry.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant, luminous emerald green in the lampshades.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white in the dress shirts and warm yellow light from the bulbs.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the green glass against a low-value, earthy background.

letterConstructionRules: Wide, circular proportions for O and C
High-waisted crossbars on E and A
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized as a simple, thin-line flourish
The 'O' in the secondary line contains a small diamond or dot
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family with varying tracking and scale for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin border frame around the entire composition

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 70s aesthetic and circular proportions.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and thin strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical studio portrait of two men with 70s hair and beards, wearing dark suits and white shirts. Place them under two glowing green glass lampshades. The background should be a dark, warm-toned landscape tapestry. A central brass fixture with a reflective sphere should hang between them.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin, geometric sans-serif text in the top right corner using an off-white color. Use wide tracking and all-caps.

verificationChecks: Are the green lamps the primary color contrast?
Is the background a textured, painterly tapestry?
Is the typography hairline-thin and geometric?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and album titles
Exact facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: Luminous quality in the green glass

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the green lamps do not look like plastic.
Verify the text is positioned in the top right and is legible but delicate.
Check that the central brass fixture is vertically aligned.
Confirm the background has a soft-focus, woven or painted appearance.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical dual portrait + glowing green glass lamps + warm tapestry background + hairline geometric typography.
